name: Wisp Thread
description: Lay one fine thread of soul force across empty air so it trembles when another soul passes close.

name: Faint Latch
description: Close a small latch of soul force round a reaching limb to hold its motion for a single breath.

name: Hush Knot
description: Tie a loose knot of soul force before a target's mind so its next thought slips and scatters.

name: Pale Loop
description: Wind a loop of soul force round the self to blunt a soul probe that tries to enter.

name: Slack Tether
description: Anchor a soul thread behind the body and pull along it to step back a pace.

name: Taut Strand
description: Draw a strand of soul force tight so any soul that touches it sends a pulse back to the user.

name: Quiet Cinch
description: Pull a soft cinch of soul force round a target's attention so its gaze stays fixed for a breath.

name: Fine Snare
description: Spread a fine snare of soul force that catches and breaks a technique being gathered by a nearby target.

name: Gentle Catch
description: Hold a soft catch of soul force before the chest to turn a soul strike aside from its line.

name: Idle Coil
description: Leave a coil of soul force pressed against a target's will so its movements come heavier and slower.

name: Thin Hitch
description: Hitch a thin soul line to a fixed point and swing round it to change footing.

name: Sleeper Knot
description: Leave a knot of soul force lying still until a soul crosses it and then draw it closed on that soul.

name: Stayed Breath
description: Press soul force on a target's chest so its breath catches and its next move comes slow.

name: Patient Stitch
description: Stitch a small seam of soul force across a target's gathering hand to stop one technique from forming.

name: Dormant Hook
description: Set a hook of soul force that lies dormant and stirs the user when another soul comes within a few paces.

name: Narrow Brace
description: Brace the soul with a narrow band of force that holds firm against a single sharp mental push.

name: Tight Hobble
description: Draw a tight hobble of soul force round a target's stride so its legs feel dragged for a breath.

name: Faint Shiver
description: Let a plain pulse of soul force run down a laid thread into the soul that touched it.

name: Slip Noose
description: Throw a plain noose of soul force round a target's intent so its next technique lags a beat.

name: Low Tripline
description: Stretch a low line of soul force and feel it tick when a soul steps over it.

name: Blunt Spring
description: Bend a blunt spring of soul force and let it snap into the soul of whoever touches it.

name: Steady Stay
description: Fix a steady stay of soul force across the self so a pushing will slides off.

name: Mild Burr
description: Leave a mild burr of soul force in a target's senses so its sense of direction wavers.

name: Lax Cord
description: Cast a lax cord of soul force to a mark and draw the body along it.

name: Silent Latch
description: Close a latch of soul force without sound over a hand or foot so it halts mid-motion.

name: Gentle Clasp
description: Hold a gentle clasp of soul force round a target's will and keep its resolve from rising.

name: Still Tell
description: Read the tell a latch gives when a soul brushes it and learn the direction and weight of that soul.

name: Light Barb
description: Send a light barb of soul force down a latch line into the soul that tripped it.

name: Brief Seal
description: Press a brief seal of soul force on a target's gathering hand to stop a technique from forming.

name: Close Veil
description: Draw a close veil of soul force round the self that dulls a probing soul-sense.

name: Fretted Catch
description: Fret a catch of soul force at the brow to turn an incoming soul jab to the side.

name: Short Slip
description: Slip a short loop of soul force over a fixed point and swing the body one stride aside.

name: Small Gin
description: Set a small toothed gin of soul force that clamps shut for a breath on a soul crossing it.

name: Toothed Latch
description: Bite a toothed latch of soul force into a gathering technique so it breaks apart.

name: Set Trigger
description: Set a trigger thread and note its tension so the first touch upon it is felt at once.

name: Needle Barb
description: Drive a needle barb of soul force along a laid thread into the soul beyond a guard.

name: Level Hold
description: Keep an even hold of soul force round the self so threads thrown by foes cannot cling.

name: Bent Tine
description: Press a bent tine of soul force on a target's will to dull its steady resolve.
